For non-admins this allows only a reply posted under the current session username; Admin keeps the privileged-role bypass.", "reused_project_semantics": "Uses `sessionType` with sentinel `\"Admin\"` for privileged-role bypass, as in DeleteForum/DeleteReply/DeleteThread/ChangeMessage. Uses `sessionUsername.equals(user)` for horizontal ownership comparison, as in ChangeMessage's non-admin branch and message.jsp's `sessionUsername.equals(user)` checks.", "reason": "The attacker authenticated as user1 can POST `user=user2`, and AddReply inserts a reply as user2 because it never compares the requested identity with the session identity.
